note: The Credit Information System Act (Republic Act No. 9510), section 4(h): negative information stays in the Corporation's database not more than three years from when it's rectified by payment or settlement. The Act was read in LawPhil's copy, the Official Gazette answering 403 and the Corporation's own site answering with an Incapsula check, not passed. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Republic Act No. 9510, Credit Information System Act (LawPhil)
sources.said: The negative information on the borrower as contained in the credit history files of borrowers should stay in the database of the Corporation unless sooner corrected, for not more than three (3) years from and after the date when the negative credit information was rectified through payment or liquidation of the debt
